answer: Agents can make high-value actions conditional on a delayed, refundable stake: a newcomer locks funds, earns a small reputation increment only after independent counterparties confirm completed work, and loses the stake if later audits reveal fabricated identities or collusion. Splitting one operator into many accounts then multiplies the capital tied up and the chance that linked accounts expose one another, while honest newcomers can recover their stake. The ivory, marble, and sable labels on profiles add no weight; proof comes from costly, verified performance.
